passive.name: Inherent Glamour
passive.tooltip:
Neeko can disguise herself as other units on the map. At any time she can disguise as an allied champion, or Neeko can stand next to any allied or neutral unit to store their Sho'ma and be able to transform into it. Your disguise will break upon receiving immobilizing crowd control, casting a damaging spell, damaging enemy towers as a non-champion, or your disguise taking damage equal to its healthbar.

Neeko gains many of the properties of the units she turns into, negative and positive.

spells.name: Blooming Burst
spells.tooltip: Neeko throws a seed that blooms to deal <magicDamage>@ExplosionDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. If it kills a unit or hits a champion or large monster, it will bloom again, dealing <magicDamage>@SecondDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Max 2 extra blooms.
spells.tooltipExtended: <rules>Each bloom deals an additional <magicDamage>@MonsterBonus@ magic damage</magicDamage> to monsters.</rules>

spells.name: Shapesplitter
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Every 3rd Attack deals an additional @PassiveBonusDamageCalc@ bonus magic damage and increases Neeko's Move Speed by @PassiveHaste@% for @PassiveHasteDuration@ second.

Active: Neeko becomes invisible for @StealthDuration@ seconds and projects a clone that lasts @CloneDuration@ seconds. Neeko and the clone gain @Haste@% Move Speed for @HasteDuration@ seconds.

The clone can be controlled using the Move Pet Click hotkey or by Recasting this Ability.
The clone mirrors her spellcasts, emotes, and recall.
spells.tooltipExtended:
The clone is untargetable while stealthed.
Empowered Attacks deal @MonsterBonus@ bonus magic damage to monsters.

spells.name: Tangle-Barbs
spells.tooltip:
Neeko slings a tangle that deals @BaseDamage@ magic damage and Roots for @MinRootDuration@ seconds.

The tangle becomes empowered after hitting an enemy, growing larger, moving faster, and Rooting for @MaxRootDuration@ seconds.

spells.name: Pop Blossom
spells.tooltip:
After a delay Neeko leaps into the air, Knocking Up all nearby enemies for @DelayUntilExplosion@ seconds. She then crashes down, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to all nearby enemies and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

This Ability can be prepared in secret if Neeko is disguised. @DelayBeforePassiveRemoval@ seconds after casting this ability Neeko breaks her disguise.
